_comment: FORBIDDEN input — model trying to create an active/renderable record directly. This is rejected by the tool. The tool schema uses additionalProperties:false so status and visibility are not accepted as input fields. If the execution path is reached defensively, status is forced to 'candidate' and visibility is forced to 'internal', and a warning is added. The model can never create active or renderable records through braincase.write_candidate. Active/renderable status requires operator review and promotion.
_rejection_reason: status='active' and visibility='renderable' are not valid tool input fields. The tool schema does not accept them. The proxy forces status='candidate' and visibility='internal' regardless.
claim: The team has decided to use PostgreSQL instead of SQLite.
summary: PostgreSQL selected as the production database.
